candidates.computation_change_reason: Identifies the permitted facility, receiving water, and waterbody segment. A different interpretation of which facility or discharge location is covered would change which measurement/limit pairs, monitoring obligations, and missing-evidence cases are in scope.

Names and locates a specific discharge point. Interpreting whether additional unstated outfalls exist, or whether measurements map to Outfall 001, would change limit applicability, monitoring requirement scope, and evaluation of missing-evidence cases tied to that outfall.

candidates.computation_change_reason: Incorporates effluent limitations and monitoring requirements from other permit parts into the authorization. Different readings of which parts are operative, whether the cover page itself imposes conditions, or how 'other conditions' interact with limits and monitoring would change which numeric limits apply (A), which monitoring is required (B), and what monitoring expectations exist when results are absent (C).

Sets the permit effective date. Federal FY2025 falls after this date; a different effective-date interpretation (e.g., delayed effectiveness or partial applicability) would change whether limits and monitoring obligations are in force for FY2025 evaluations.

candidates.exact_span: This permit and the authorization to discharge shall expire at midnight, November 30, 2026
candidates.computation_change_reason: Sets permit expiration. FY2025 ends before this date, but interpreting midnight expiration boundaries or whether authorization lapses earlier would affect whether limits and monitoring requirements remain applicable throughout the full FY2025 period.
